Larchmont Spotlights

  • Annual 2025/26 Parking Permits On Sale Now

    Purchase or Renew Your Parking Permit! Learn More

  • Get Updates!

    Get the latest on all things #Larchmont right to your phone or email! Learn More

  • Tennis/Pickleball Permit Sales Live

    Purchase your tennis/pickleball permit today! Learn More
  • Larchmont Village Hall was built in 1922, and recently celebrated its 100th anniversary.
  • Before incorporating as a Village, Larchmont was a 19th century summer resort destination for New York City’s elite.
  • Two thriving business districts forge Larchmont's vibrant and scenic downtown.
  • Flint Park is one of nine public parks to call Larchmont home. Larchmont also has the privately-owned Manor Park.
  • "Larchmont" gets its name from the Larch tree; several of which were planted in front of the historic Manor House.

Scam Alert: Fake Building Permit & Fee Payment Emails

Fraudsters impersonating Larchmont planning and zoning departments are emailing fake permit and land use fee invoices. The Village never requests payments via unsolicited or unofficial emails. Verify invoices directly with the Building Department first.
